elevenlabsPrompt:
[firm] Stop answering spam calls. Make your iPhone ignore them.

[confident] Here's the fix. Turn on Silence Unknown Callers.

[friendly] Open Settings, then Apps, then Phone. Flip on Unknown Callers. Contacts still ring. Strangers go to voicemail.

[delighted] Your phone only rings for people you know.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
